non_pde_controls.selection_rule: On validation only, select the eligible value with the smallest absolute relative MSE gap to frozen NP; lower strength wins an exact tie. If no value is within 5%, retain the closest as UNMATCHED and prohibit a matched-control claim.

selection_rule: Primary NP lambda is fixed at 0.0035; non-PDE strength uses technical validation reconstruction matching; detector mixing ratio uses validation pooled COCO AP only.
stopping_rule: Exactly 8960 detector optimizer updates; final checkpoint is primary and intermediate milestones are diagnostic only.

compact_diffusion.sampling_rule: DDIM eta=0 deterministic with exactly 50 production steps; 10-step random-weight mechanics fixture passed; trained quality remains an execution result, not a pre-lock fact
